FULL BODY LOCK: Even if the RIGHT action reference is cropped or cut at the waist, restore the complete original lower body, legs and shoes from the LEFT full body reference in EVERY frame. No bust portraits or floating torsos. Depict all unsupported seated postures as natural crouches with both legs visible unless an explicit original wheelchair applies. FIXED FURNITURE BAN: Ignore fixed furniture visible in the reference action pose. Draw ONLY the person, clothing and small handheld tools. DO NOT draw any window frame, chair, full counter/table, steering-wheel pedestal, telescope tripod, boat, vehicle, ground platform, background or floor. Gesture toward the invisible station where relevant; preserve identity and handheld tool. CRITICAL: Produce ONE SHORT CYCLIC WORK MOTION, not a story of preparing, finishing, picking up, putting down or handing over. All 8 poses remain in the SAME working state holding the same single reference tool throughout. Do not add extra equipment such as scales, buckets, extra hammers, bowls or duplicate binoculars. For long rods/nets/paddles keep them compact within each sprite cell, never crossing a gutter or extending beyond the cell. Frame 8 matches frame 1 with the tool still held. Row 2 S23-C086 uses a wheelchair: preserve the complete same wheelchair and seated body in every frame. Never show walking legs or standing. Animate hands, head and wheels with the chair staying complete. Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation sprite sheet for Wacha Wacha Town. The supplied reference contains FOUR existing characters, top to bottom, each shown in two original poses. Create new poses of EXACTLY these four people, one person per row. Preserve each face, body proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, hat, accessories, outfit construction and EXACT clothing colors. No redesigns or recolors. Match their crisp hand-painted storybook chibi rendering and gentle overhead three-quarter perspective. True transparent alpha background. No floor, scenery, stairs, labels, text, grid lines or shadows under feet. Every cell has generous empty gutters and complete head, hands and feet. Keep fixed character scale and foot baseline across a row; animate limbs and posture, do not translate the character across cells. EXACT GRID: FOUR equal rows by EIGHT equal columns, 32 separate sprites. Each row is one expressive, coherent EIGHT-FRAME seamless loop of the stated role action, with clear anticipation, contact/effort, follow-through and recovery. Hands interact convincingly at waist/chest height with portable tools or an unseen counter in front-right. Keep the original portable tools; do not attach a large counter, building, chair or floor to the sprite. Facing front-right three-quarter. Make genuinely different body poses, not identical copies. Landscape canvas, ideally 1536 by 1024. Stage: 昼と夜の大都会. Stage locations: 駅前交差点|商店街|オフィス2階|屋上庭園|公園|路面電車の停留所|劇場街|住宅路地.
Row 1: S23-C081, 公園で犬を散歩する人 1; action context: 犬と散歩する.
Row 2: S23-C086, 車いすで移動する住人 1; action context: 車いすを自走する.
Row 3: S23-C091, 杖で歩く住人 1; action context: 杖を使って歩く.
Row 4: S23-C096, 昼と夜の大都会のカメラマン 1; action context: 写真を撮る.
LOOP CONTINUITY LOCK: Treat the LEFT reference pose as the authority for the face, body and clothing; the RIGHT pose supplies the role tool. Hold the SAME tools and SAME colors/count of all portable props in ALL EIGHT frames, including frame 8. Never finish by switching to the empty-handed walking reference. Use small continuous hand, wrist, elbow, knee, hip and head movements around the fixed tool; pose 8 must naturally return to pose 1. Do not make props disappear/reappear or randomly recolor. Do not change a finished product into raw material within this short loop. For juggling or balloon work, every frame has exactly the same balls/balloons in the same colors, only positions change. A camera, paddle, net, watering can or steering wheel stays visible through the complete cycle.
notes: 犬と散歩、車いす、杖、撮影。犬/リードと車いすの大輪・小輪・足台が全8コマ保持され、歩行人物への置換なし。パックでも全身と装備を確認。
